array.string: D=/Users/user/trading-rh-options; L="$HOME/Library/Logs/options-live.log"; if ! (git -C "$D" fetch --quiet origin main && git -C "$D" merge --ff-only --quiet FETCH_HEAD); then echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) [warn] could not update $D — running the existing checkout" >> "$L"; fi; if [ -x "$D/scripts/options-live-run.sh" ]; then OPTIONS_DESK_REPO="$D" exec "$D/scripts/options-live-run.sh" guard; else echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) [fail] runner missing at $D" >> "$L"; fi
